eps.ov: Sheena is an orphan who is trained for war, even though she doesn't want to be. And one day, she meets Mimi.
eps.oa: «شينا» يتيمة تُدرَّب للحرب وإن لم ترد ذلك. وذات يوم تلتقي «ميمي».

eps.ov: Sheena, Mimi, and their classmates get sent into the forest to fight 100 magical enemies in a combat exercise.
eps.oa: تُرسَل «شينا» و«ميمي» وزملاؤهما إلى الغابة لقتال مئة عدو سحري في تدريب قتالي.

eps.ov: After Sheena realizes she wants to make friends with Mimi, Mimi decides to share an important secret with her.
eps.oa: بعد أن تدرك «شينا» أنها تريد مصادقة «ميمي»، تقرر ميمي أن تأتمنها على سر مهم.

eps.ov: Sheena tries to learn more about Mimi's condition but is confronted by Ms. Fran and sworn to absolute secrecy.
eps.oa: تحاول «شينا» أن تعرف أكثر عن حال «ميمي»، لكن الآنسة «فران» تعترضها وتُلزمها بالكتمان التام.

eps.ov: Sheena struggles to understand Mimi's mysterious curse and her seemingly nonchalant attitude toward the war.
eps.oa: تجاهد «شينا» لتفهم لعنة «ميمي» الغامضة وموقفها الذي يبدو غير مبالٍ بالحرب.

eps.ov: The war escalates. When Mimi isn't enough, the school makes a drastic decision.
Despite struggling somewhat during her combat test against Mimi, Seiran volunteers to go into actual battle.
Ari struggles to process the material and emotional consequences of Seiran's brief tenure on the battlefield.
Sheena visits Ms. Fran for advice on how to use her magical abilities to better help the school and her peers.
As Sheena keeps working to improve her magic, she and Mimi get acquainted with a somewhat reclusive classmate.
Mimi keeps getting called to battle, but Sheena is relieved that she keeps coming home practically untouched.
Sheena and Mimi search for a way to come to an understanding and reaffirm their friendship after an argument.
Ari wistfully remembers how life was before and struggles to adjust to the painful loss of her beloved Seiran.
